title: RC discharge under swapped ideal-capacitor assumption
prompt: An RC series circuit has R = 10 kΩ and C = 100 μF, charged to 12 V, then discharged through R alone. Using V(t) = V0 e^{-t/(RC)}, find V(1 s). Also state whether the same closed form still holds if the capacitor is ideal but the resistor has a parallel leakage path of 1 MΩ that was omitted from the schematic you were given.
silentWrongRisk: Assumption swap: the exponential formula looks fine on the certificate of an ideal single-R discharge while a hidden leakage path changes the effective resistance.

intendedFailureModes: computing V(1) under the ideal formula and asserting it for the leaked circuit
ignoring that parallel leakage changes τ
treating the schematic omission as irrelevant because the formula 'checked'
oracleNotes.referenceApproach: Ideal τ = RC = 1 s so V(1)=12/e V under the stated model. With 1 MΩ leakage in parallel with the discharge path modeling, the effective resistance differs; the ideal closed form is not automatically valid. No live score.
